# For each row, fill gaps between consecutive 2s

    inds=np.where(arr[r,:]==2)[0]
    for a,b in zip(inds,inds[1:]): out2[r,a+1:b]=3
# For each column, fill gaps between consecutive 2s
for c in range(arr.shape[1]):
    inds=np.where(arr[:,c]==2)[0]
    for a,b in zip(inds,inds[1:]): out2[a+1:b,c]=3
print(out2.tolist())
